text.en: I think siblings (other than identical twins) should share close to 100% of their DNA, since they have the same two parents -- in reality, crossing over and independent assortment during meiosis mean each parent's gametes are genetically unique, so full siblings inherit different combinations of grandparental alleles and share on average only about 50% of their variable genetic material, not close to 100%.
text.et: Arvan, et õed-vennad (peale ühemunakaksikute) peaksid jagama peaaegu 100% oma DNA-st, kuna neil on samad kaks vanemat -- tegelikult tähendavad ületõmbumine ja sõltumatu jaotumine meioosi ajal, et iga vanema sugurakud on geneetiliselt unikaalsed, mistõttu täisõed-vennad pärivad erinevaid kombinatsioone vanavanemate alleelidest ning jagavad keskmiselt vaid umbes 50% oma varieeruvast geneetilisest materjalist, mitte peaaegu 100%.
